notes: Booklet images are low-resolution; several piece identities and rests_on relations (body slope/bracket, step 8 head top, location of 2nd clip, 3rd 2x2 plate, 47457 and 5 jumpers) are best guesses made so counts match the parts list exactly (58 pieces).
Two grey 1x2 socket plates form the body base with the red 2x2 plate; leg towballs fit the sockets, axles into the Technic brick axle holes.
Flames: large trans-red flames clip into the two 1x1 clip plates; small trans-orange flames sit on jumper studs.
Sub-assemblies (legs x2, arms x2, curved wings x3) are listed per copy; head, legs and arms attach to the body via other_joins.
